The '''computer records section''' was the area of [[Anglebay Station]] medical center, located on [[Telos IV]], that housed the medical histories of all individuals who had been treated at the station. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] [[Attack on Anglebay Station|destroyed]] Anglebay Station in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to hide the fact that his treatment at the station had made him a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]].
